# Versioniq

> Versioniq is an open-source app version manager for the Nextcloud workspace.

Versioniq is an open-source app version manager for the Nextcloud workspace. It pins and rolls back any installed Nextcloud app, lets administrators pick versions from multiple sources (the official store, GitHub releases, custom repositories), and keeps an audit trail of every install and upgrade. The app is in active development; consult the docs for the current release status. Released under EUPL-1.2 and maintained by Conduction since 2019.

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://app-versions.conduction.nl/docs/intro): main entry, including tutorials, user guide, and admin guide.
- [API reference](https://app-versions.conduction.nl/api): OpenAPI documentation.

## Optional

- [Install](https://www.conduction.nl/install): self-host on your Nextcloud instance.
- [Source code](https://github.com/ConductionNL/versioniq): repository and issue tracker.
- [App page](https://www.conduction.nl/apps/app-versions): product positioning on conduction.nl.
